knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

training_data <- readRDS("training_data.rds")

predictors <- c(
  "HomeAway",
  "TeamRankCategory",
  "OpponentRankCategory",
  "Round",
  "OpponentRound",
  "Days",
  "DWF",
  "DLF",
  "DDF",
  "DAS",
  "DDS",
  "DRF",
  "DYF",
  "DFF",
  "DCS",
  "DSTF",
  "DSF"
)
# Keep the same observations for all candidate models
model_data <- training_data %>%
  select(Goals, all_of(predictors)) %>%
  na.omit()

null_model <- glm(
  Goals ~ 1,
  data = model_data,
  family = poisson(link = "log")
)

full_model <- glm(
  reformulate(predictors, response = "Goals"),
  data = model_data,
  family = poisson(link = "log")
)


# Forward selection: start with the null model
forward_model <- step(
  null_model,
  scope = list(
    lower = formula(null_model),
    upper = formula(full_model)
  ),
  direction = "forward",
  trace = 0
)

# Backward selection: start with the full model
backward_model <- step(
  full_model,
  direction = "backward",
  trace = 0
)

# Both directions: start with the null model and allow
# predictors to be added or removed at each step
both_model <- step(
  null_model,
  scope = list(
    lower = formula(null_model),
    upper = formula(full_model)
  ),
  direction = "both",
  trace = 0
)
```

```{r}
formula(forward_model)
formula(backward_model)
formula(both_model)
```
```{r}
poisson_formula <- Goals ~ DAS + HomeAway + DSF +
  TeamRankCategory + DDS + OpponentRankCategory +
  DCS + DYF + DSTF
```

expanding-window validation:
```{r}
seasons <- training_data %>%
  distinct(Year) %>%
  mutate(start_year = as.integer(substr(Year, 1, 4))) %>%
  arrange(start_year) %>%
  pull(Year)

cv_results <- data.frame(
  Season = character(),
  Points_MAE = numeric(),
  Points_RMSE = numeric(),
  Outcome_Accuracy = numeric(),
  Kendall_Rank = numeric()
)

for (i in 2:length(seasons)) {

  # All seasons before the validation season
  train_fold <- training_data %>%
    filter(Year %in% seasons[1:(i - 1)])

  # Entire next season
  valid_fold <- training_data %>%
    filter(Year == seasons[i])

  # Fit Poisson GLM
  poisson_model <- glm(
    poisson_formula,
    data = train_fold,
    family = poisson(link = "log")
  )

  # Predict expected goals for each team
  valid_fold <- valid_fold %>%
    mutate(
      predicted_goals = predict(
        poisson_model,
        newdata = valid_fold,
        type = "response"
      )
    )

  # Pair home and away teams for each match
  match_predictions <- valid_fold %>%
    select(
      Year, match_id, HomeAway, Team, Goals, predicted_goals
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = HomeAway,
      values_from = c(Team, Goals, predicted_goals)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      goal_difference =
        predicted_goals_Home - predicted_goals_Away,

      predicted_result = case_when(
        abs(goal_difference) <= 0.225 ~ "D",
        goal_difference > 0.225 ~ "H",
        TRUE ~ "A"
      ),

      actual_result = case_when(
        Goals_Home > Goals_Away ~ "H",
        Goals_Home < Goals_Away ~ "A",
        TRUE ~ "D"
      ),

      predicted_home_points = case_when(
        predicted_result == "H" ~ 3,
        predicted_result == "D" ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),

      predicted_away_points = case_when(
        predicted_result == "A" ~ 3,
        predicted_result == "D" ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),

      actual_home_points = case_when(
        actual_result == "H" ~ 3,
        actual_result == "D" ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),

      actual_away_points = case_when(
        actual_result == "A" ~ 3,
        actual_result == "D" ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0
      )
    )

  # Sum predicted and actual points for each team
  team_points <- bind_rows(
    match_predictions %>%
      transmute(
        Team = Team_Home,
        predicted_points = predicted_home_points,
        actual_points = actual_home_points
      ),
    match_predictions %>%
      transmute(
        Team = Team_Away,
        predicted_points = predicted_away_points,
        actual_points = actual_away_points
      )
  ) %>%
    group_by(Team) %>%
    summarise(
      predicted_points = sum(predicted_points),
      actual_points = sum(actual_points),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      predicted_rank = min_rank(desc(predicted_points)),
      actual_rank = min_rank(desc(actual_points))
    )

  # Evaluate predicted versus actual season points and rankings
  cv_results <- rbind(
    cv_results,
    data.frame(
      Season = seasons[i],

      Points_MAE = mean(abs(
        team_points$actual_points -
          team_points$predicted_points
      )),

      Points_RMSE = sqrt(mean(
        (team_points$actual_points -
           team_points$predicted_points)^2
      )),

      Outcome_Accuracy = mean(
        match_predictions$predicted_result ==
          match_predictions$actual_result
      ),

      Kendall_Rank = cor(
        team_points$predicted_rank,
        team_points$actual_rank,
        method = "kendall"
      )
    )
  )
}

cv_results
```
